RPA Tools: UiPath, Power Automate Desktop & Cloud

Other: Process Optimization, Secure Authentication (MFA), API Integration
raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Hindustan Coca-Cola Beverages Pvt. Ltd. | Senior RPA Developer
April 2025 – Present
Designed and executed a UiPath-to-Power Automate migration plan, reducing license costs significantly.
Delivered 2 successful bot migrations to Power Automate, ensuring seamless business continuity.
Built reusable automation components in Power Automate to accelerate future development.
Developed 5+ end-to-end automation solutions using UiPath.
Developed a SAP-integrated bot, streamlining core business processes.
Actively resolved production issues and implemented change requests, improving bot reliability.
Created a sample Agentic AI use case (LangChain & CrewAI) to demonstrate AI-powered automation.
Accenture Pvt. Ltd. | Application Development Analyst
October 2021 – April 2025
Developed 10+ end-to-end automation solutions using UiPath.
Developed 8+ end-to-end automation solutions using Power Automate Desktop & Cloud.
Migrated around 160+ Automations from UiPath to Power Automate
Built a RE Framework template in Power Automate, standardizing automation design.
Automated credential expiry monitoring for third-party portals, reducing downtime risks.
Created automation to track UiPath license utilization, improving resource planning.
Designed Power Automate bots using JIRA APIs, enhancing project tracking.
Migrated multiple automations from UiPath to Power Automate with minimal disruption.
Classified - CONFIDENTIAL

Implemented MFA login in UiPath Orchestrator & Action Center, strengthening security.
Worked on Kibana dashboards & monitoring tools for automation performance analytics.
Upgraded UiPath infrastructure from 2020.10.2 to 2022.10.4 (Classical to Modern).
Contributed to client interactions, TDDs, deployments, and UAT support, ensuring smooth project delivery.
Recognized with Best Employee Award and Pinnacle Award FY24 (Accenture).
